title: Case: Recipient requests a call shortly before arrival
context: The route is booked, but the customer needs time to move from a nearby studio to the delivery door. The driver has not yet departed.
initial_request: Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.

events.body: DL-4117 is on the 2027-02-05 afternoon route. For this route we can add a call request using the verified number already in the order record; we cannot guarantee an exact advance interval.
Could the driver call shortly before reaching me? I work in the studio next door and need a few minutes to walk over. Use my saved order contact.
Please record Aurelio’s request on DL-4117: call the verified saved order contact shortly before arrival, if route conditions allow. No contact change is requested.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Dispatch, Quillmoor Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Recorded instruction is not proof of a call or of arrival.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-004: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
